EEL4664.title: Kinematics and Control of Robotic Systems
EEL4664.prerequisites: Florida Poly, the only carrier: not confirmed (its online catalogue could not be read for this guide). Expect calculus III, differential equations, linear algebra and a controls background: on Florida Poly's B.S. EE flowchart it is a senior Robotics concentration elective beside EEL4612 Control System Design and EEL4660 Autonomous Robotic Systems. Check Florida Poly's catalogue for the exact prerequisite and grade before registering. *** The statewide title for EEL x664 is 'Autonomous Robotic Systems', which Florida Poly teaches as EEL4660; send a syllabus on transfer.

offering_notes.summary: One public carrier, Florida Polytechnic University, at 3 credits. The statewide title for EEL x664 is Autonomous Robotic Systems, which Florida Poly teaches as EEL4660. UCF carried EEL4664 until 2009.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida's convention of 15 contact hours per credit for a lecture course; Florida Poly does not publish hours and the statewide record marks no laboratory.
